name: Interactive Slice and Point-Based Volume Rendering
definition: Renders a 3D segmentation volume by dynamically extracting a 2D slice from the volume data, uploading it to a 2D texture, and drawing a slice plane that samples it, while overlaying segmentation labels as 3D points at voxel coordinates.
summary: Interactive Slice and Point-Based Volume Rendering visualizes 3D segmentation by decoupling continuous intensity slices from discrete label points, enabling distinct rendering pipelines and per-label coloring.
